clauses.clause: 24 occupants + 0–5 L5 survivors (same ids, full health); routines sit/talk/treat/rest/share; nobody idle > 3 s; no gun on seated/lying people.
clauses.note: Both tiers: actual mortal canonical L5 route hands24 residents+5 rescued through production completeCampaignLevel into L6. All29 same IDs and full HP in11 half-second samples (319 actor observations per tier); purposeful sit/talk/treat/rest/share/guard story stays active for5s, no idle>3s. Every seated/lying actor uses npc-sit/death-side, which the actual renderer stows. Low Okafor retains stored rifle state, so his exact carried save was rendered after physical W/idle: both detail frames show empty hands, nearby rifle belongs to standing Rosa. Physical preset images at both renderer qualities corroborate routine presentation; IDs come from native ledger.
